verdicts.notes:
Addresses check out. 0x802D0968 is `bl 0x802B68F0` (getGlbResource, r3=name, r4=arc). 0x802D09DC is `bl 0x802D0CE0` (set(JSURandomInputStream*), r3=r29=this, r4=r1+8), followed by `mr r31,r3`. J2DScreen::search is at 0x802D1150 and J2DPane::add at 0x802D05C8; add calls move, which calls calcMtx, so the matrix stays in sync. The layout is confirmed: mTag +0x08, mBounds +0x0C (i.x +0x0C, i.y +0x10, f.x +0x14, f.y +0x18), and JSUTree at +0xB0, where *(+0xB0) is mHead and the JSUPtrLink is mObject +0, mList +4, mPrev +8, mNext +0xC. Nothing between hook A and hook B calls getGlbResource through 0x802D0968, so ws_last_blo can't be overwritten. The pass is sound because fopMsgM_pane_parts_set (f_op_msg_mng.cpp:9791) reads getBounds() after the hook. I checked the d_meter users of Orig (menuPlusMove, magicTransScale, heart layout, zakoEnemyMove, item_parts, clock and tekari): they are all Orig-relative or recomputed, so they follow.
The finder MISSED a failure mode. J2DScreen::draw passes mbClipToParent (+0xCC) into J2DPane::draw (J2DPane.cpp:151-203). When clip is true (it always is with J2DOrthoGraph, since getGrafType()==1), each child's mDrawBounds is intersected with its parent's, and the child is skipped entirely when the result is empty. The screen and ROOT bounds are 0..640 (INF1 / PAN1), so on a scissored screen a pre-shift past x=640 (or past 0) is clipped or vanishes. Three screens are affected: time_swim_1 (d_meter.cpp:1095; `li r0,1; stb r0,0xCC(r3)` at 0x801F066C/70), auction1 (d_auction_screen.cpp:451) and d_message.cpp:942. For those, the rule must move the J2DScreen itself (J2DPane::move(screen, ±S, 0)), which carries its own clip box along, or widen both the screen and ROOT. Shifting ROOT's children does not work there. Note too that operate_wind_mask, baton_input and auction1/2 have a top-level 'BACK' PIC1 as a sibling of ROOT, so a fallback of 'root = screen' would also shift BACK.

corrected.fix: Same two hooks as proposed: hook_branchlink at 0x802D0968 and at 0x802D09DC. Add a fourth rule kind, SCREEN_L or SCREEN_R, for screens drawn with setScissor(true): J2DPane_move((J2DPane*)scrn, ±S, 0) on the J2DScreen itself, with its children left untouched. Use it only where no code uses that screen's pane Orig as an absolute coordinate. time_swim_1 qualifies: its panes are moved only in y, d_meter.cpp:6301-6335. auction1 also qualifies (initPosSet is Orig-relative). Every other HUD screen keeps the per-child pre-shift. Unknown names default to no change.

verdicts.notes: 0x803F7D68 = -9.0 and 0x803F7D6C = 650.0, at r2-0x7F98/-0x7F94. A scan of the DOL finds exactly six loads: 0x8000A6B0/B4 (setUpRectangle), 0x8000B03C/4C and 0x8000BA00/10 (mDoGph_Painter). m_Do_graphic.cpp lines 1322, 1572-1573 and 1890 match. S = 329.5*(F-1) is correct for a box widened symmetrically about 320.5. The 2D particles (JPADrawInfo with viewMtx trans 320,240, m_Do_graphic.cpp:1890-1899) draw in the same graf ortho; JPA only uses fovy for projection-texture mtx. So particles placed at pane-320 follow the compression, as the finder assumes.

The .blo rects match a re-parse of main_parts1/3. I checked menuPlusMove (d_meter.cpp:4782-4806). With the map shown, the D-pad arrows sit at mapCentre + (Orig[i] - Orig[1]) + HIO 0x9c, so a uniform pre-shift cancels and moving the map gives -S once. With the map hidden (moveStatus 4/5) they follow the current positions of field_0x12f0/0x1948, which are themselves pre-shifted. crs1 (field_0x02c0) = Orig + HIO 0x9c, so it needs the pre-shift. Heart layout (1484-1490) is relative to heart[0].Orig. magicTransScale scales the root children about mbb1's Orig. The two panes it scales about the origin (0x1130, 0x1168) are children with relative bounds, so they're unaffected. The fix stands.

Gecko facts check out: 0x801F0B70 is `lha r0,0x50(r5)` with r5 = 0x803E6908 (g_meterHIO). 0x801F0700 is `lfs f1,-0x4AA4(r2)` (0.0f) in the sMainParts2 draw. The Gecko rewrites that to -0x6A34(r2) = 0x803F92CC, whose vanilla value is 114.0f; that constant is otherwise loaded only by dCamera useItem0/1EvCamera, so the Gecko reuses a camera constant. The particles at d_meter.cpp:2697, 4976/4985/5017 and 6078/6091/6170 use the current mPosCenter of pre-shifted root panes, so they follow. Item flight (6240-6273) targets field_0x2080[].mPosCenter, so it follows the buttons.

Pre-shifting them would be harmless, but excluding them is cleaner. Note that ben2 (cx 342) would fall into R without the exception list, so the list is needed. Confirmed at d_meter.cpp:4795-4805: dVar13 = mapLeftUpX - 0x19, then paneTrans(field_0x02f8, dVar13 - 7 + HIO 0x64, ...) on Orig. A pre-shift plus a moved map would give -2S, so wiy1 must be in the exception list (its cx of 132 would otherwise be caught by BY_CX).

The ctor disassembly at 0x80205990-0x802059DC matches exactly (sth 35@+8, 338@+A, -180@+C, 590@+14, 150@+16). g_meter_mapHIO = 0x803E68DC (size 0x20). moveMapCtrlDisp (d_meter.cpp:7733-7743) sets X = field_0x8 + field_0x4 every frame; the hide target is field_0xc - field_0x8, so shifting both by S keeps the slide distance. field_0x14 is read only in initMapCtrlDisp. The map frame spans X-8..X+128 (d_map.cpp mapDrawFrame), so the vanilla hidden right edge of -52 is correct; with the fix it moves to -162, which is off a box at -119.5.

Disassembly matches: 640/-9/659 at r2-0x7ACC/-0x7AC8/-0x7AC4 (0x803F8234/38/3C). A scan finds these loaded only at 0x8004A3A8/CC/D8, so a data rewrite is safe. `li r3,116` at 0x8004A428, `li r5,109` at 0x8004A42C, `li r4,0` at 0x8004A444. Stores to r13-0x75FC (0x803F6AE4 X), -0x7600 (0x803F6AE0 Y), -0x75F8 (0x803F6AE8 W), -0x75F4 (0x803F6AEC H). The only caller is `bl 0x8004A3A4` at 0x8004A64C. The formula is right: the map is 120 ortho wide (frame 0..120), and 116/F px matches 120*640/(659F).

Following this as written breaks the air meter. dDlst_2DMETER1_c::draw sets sScrTimer1->mbClipToParent = 1 every frame (0x801F066C `li r0,1`; 0x801F0670 `stb r0,0xCC(r3)`) before `bl J2DScreen::draw` at 0x801F0684. With clip on, J2DPane::draw intersects each child's draw bounds with the screen's and ROOT's (0..640). An ALL_R pre-shift puts msk1, main, soul and kg00 at x 643..707: the intersection is empty and they are not drawn at all (J2DPane.cpp:192). time_swim_2 is not scissored (draw bl 0x801F06A0), and tekari takes its position from wk00's Orig (field_0x2c88, d_meter.cpp:6689-6722), so that screen must keep the per-child pre-shift.

corrected.fix: time_swim_2.blo → ALL_R per-child pre-shift, so tekari follows wk00's Orig. time_swim_1.blo → SCREEN_R: J2DPane_move(screen, +S, 0) on the J2DScreen itself inside the anchor pass, with no child pre-shift. J2DScreen::draw then puts the screen's own clip box at [S, 640+S], and none of time_swim_1's pane Origs is used as an absolute x (d_meter.cpp:6301-6335 moves them only in y). Code alternative: hook_branchlink the `bl 0x802D0F2C` at 0x801F0684 with a wrapper that adds S to f1. That is the Gecko's 0x801F0678 approach and is equivalent. Don't combine it with a pre-shift of time_swim_1.
